Understand Market Rhythms with askSlim Cycle Analysis
In today’s video, we provide an objective look at the stock market using our proprietary cycle analysis methodology. Evolved from the pioneering work of J.M. Hurst, our approach focuses on the "heartbeat" of the market to help you identify high-probability windows for direction, timing, and price projections.
Trading isn't about mastering the market—it's about mastering your process and aligning with the natural cycles of price action.

Refine Your Trade Planning at askSlim.com
Access professional-grade tools and analysis curated by 50-year veteran trader Steve “Slim” Miller and our analyst team.

The askSlim Methodology
Our approach is fundamentally built on three core pillars to provide an objective look at market behavior:   
Cycle Analysis: We apply proprietary cycle analysis to reveal hidden market rhythms and identify high-probability windows for direction and timing.   
Momentum Analysis: Using our proprietary indicators like the Slim Ribbon and Reversal Scout, we help you stay on the right side of the trend with real-time tracking.   
Swing High/Swing Low Analysis: We utilize objective data on price projections and turning points to help refine your trade planning and execution.
